This PR adds a simple test line to the bottom of the README.md file to verify that the pull request creation workflow is functioning correctly. The change adds a single line: "*This is a dummy change to test the PR workflow - added by Devin*"

## Motivation

**This is a test PR and should not be merged.** It was created solely to demonstrate and verify the PR workflow functionality.
